label: And I'Ll Bite,
title: And I'll bite,
displayText:
And I'll bite,
 If my neck a twist you gave
 I'd bring you to an early grave.'

Quite frightened, the dwarf set down the cage, and the goose gazed at
him with sad wise-looking eyes and sighed again.
